routeInventory.note: Single route. /api/waitlist is a POST endpoint, not a page. See templates/templates.json routeInventory.verificationNote.

structurallyUnusual: Single route, single template: no other pages exist; none may be invented.

Live third-party endpoint: the original POSTs {email} to /api/waitlist (real signup). The clone stubs it locally; PageSpec submitTarget is closed to 'local-stub' and endpointPolicy is pinned to must-not-reuse-live-endpoint (semantic ENDPOINT_POLICY_PINNED + verify_all pinned-role check).

Real live company (Shelf / savetoshelf.com): logo, app icons and third-party brand tag icons are must-not-reproduce-real-brand; Plausible analytics (analytics.mammutstudios.com) is intentionally excluded.
No raster content images/video/og:image: thumbnails are CSS colour blocks (asset role mockup.thumbnail-color-block, css-color-block-only); no photo role exists.

Three sections (hero.intro, hero.demo-mockup, story.why-funnel) live inside ONE header whose bottom edge is a scroll-driven clip-path; they cannot be reordered or separated (BOOKMARK_HEADER_SEQUENCE).
The nav CTA #waitlist targets the hero form; the closing waitlist section has no id.
The hero demo scrim ([data-demo-scrim]) is never activated by any shipped script and is kept inert.
